app_tagline: Badminton Session Cost Splitter & Payment Tracker
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO x SPORT COURT HIGH VISIBILITY

theme_strategy.high_contrast_mode: Gym-Bright Light Theme with crisp Obsidian text and Optic Volt / Emerald Court accents for maximum readability under harsh overhead hall lights.
theme_strategy.dark_mode_support: Toggleable Night Mode (Obsidian background with Electric Emerald and Optic Yellow highlights).

headings.style_notes: Never use Inter for headings. Use Outfit or Barlow Condensed for athletic energy.

numbers_currency.usage: All money amounts, ₱ totals, per-player court + shuttle breakdowns, shuttle counts.

visual_enhancers.court_lines_pattern: Subtle 1px court marking SVG vector grid background on key cards.
visual_enhancers.shuttlecock_iconography: Badminton racquet & shuttlecock SVG accents on header and shareable card.
visual_enhancers.ticket_tear_effect: Scalloped or dashed bottom border on the public share summary card to feel like a court pass/receipt.
visual_enhancers.screenshot_ready_card: Max width 480px centered mobile phone view wrapper with drop shadow, border, rounded-2xl, and high contrast typography for crisp phone screenshots.

screens.name: Home / Past Sessions
screens.description: Displays past badminton sessions card list, total collected summary metric, quick filter (All, Unsettled, Settled), and 'New Session' prominent FAB/button.

screens.name: New / Edit Session
screens.description: Form with venue, date, court fee, shuttle count, price per shuttle, currency picker (default PHP ₱), and dynamic player list with quick add tags. Live sticky footer calculating instant share per player.

screens.name: Session Detail
screens.description: Interactive roster list with toggle switches or tap cards to mark Paid/Unpaid, progress bar for total collected vs outstanding, quick WhatsApp/SMS copy text generator, and 'Open Shareable Summary' CTA.

screens.name: Shareable Public Summary
screens.description: The flagship polished screen. No login required. Pristine mobile card with breakdown of court fee portion + shuttle portion per player, total collected vs outstanding status, payment instructions box (GCash/Maya/Bank details), and 'Made with CourtSplit' branding badge.

data_testid_strategy.rules: All interactive buttons, input fields, toggles, financial totals, and share cards MUST have a kebab-case data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the web application using standard React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI components.
Ensure default currency is set to PHP (₱) across all calculations and displays.

Ensure live calculation formula strictly follows: totalShuttleCost = numberOfShuttles * pricePerShuttle; totalCost = totalCourtFee + totalShuttleCost; perPlayerShare = totalCost / numberOfPlayers; courtPortion = totalCourtFee / numberOfPlayers; shuttlePortion = totalShuttleCost / numberOfPlayers.

Prioritize the Shareable Summary screen styling: Make it look like a high-end digital receipt/pass with court accent lines, crystal clear text, individual breakdown of court vs shuttle fees, and GCash/Maya payment notes.
Ensure touch targets are at least 44px with large high-contrast buttons for fast one-handed mobile operation inside a brightly lit badminton hall.
Include quick copy feature to format the roster into plain text ready to paste directly into group chats (Messenger/Viber/WhatsApp).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default tables. Wrap content in clean cards with explicit padding p-4 md:p-6.
Ensure all monetary amounts use tabular numbers (font-mono) so numbers align neatly when stacked.
Use sonner for notifications when status changes or text is copied.
Always add data-testid attributes to all form controls, list items, total badges, and interactive buttons.
